name: wfthkttn
description: Claude Code mods: a sidebar for tools, model providers and their limits, agent runs and reviews by other models, the prompt cache, and the session's conversation for other mods

plugins.name: cc-sidebar
plugins.description: An always-on sidebar that other plugins put their tools on: tool icons with badges, switches, drawers

plugins.name: cc-providers
plugins.description: Model providers in one place for other mods: models, prices, quota, headless runs and per-session spending limits, and a launcher for sessions on other providers

plugins.name: cc-bus
plugins.description: Optional wiring between mods: a mod asks a topic, every loaded mod that knows it answers, and neither needs the other installed

plugins.name: cc-agents
plugins.description: Headless agent runs on any provider cc-providers knows, for other mods: started, continued, stopped and kept across reloads

plugins.name: cc-cache
plugins.description: Prompt cache countdown in the sidebar, a keep-alive for large idle sessions, and compaction from the sidebar or Telegram

plugins.name: cc-conversation
plugins.description: The session and its person as $.conversation, for mods that carry questions, approvals and messages elsewhere

plugins.name: cc-crew
plugins.description: Reviews by other providers' models under one tool, with enforced read limits, and a sidebar tab for reviews, agents, spending limits and quota
